import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, hstack
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import lightgbm as lgb


def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        return pd.DataFrame(json.load(f))


# Load datasets
df_train = load_json("./input/train/train.json")
df_test = load_json("./input/test/test.json")

target_col = "requester_received_pizza"
y = df_train[target_col]

# Identify common numeric features (exclude IDs and non-available-in-test columns)
exclude_ids = {
    "request_id",
    "requester_username",
    "giver_username_if_known",
    "requester_subreddits_at_request",
}
numeric_feats = [
    c
    for c in df_train.columns
    if c not in exclude_ids
    and df_train[c].dtype in ["int64", "float64"]
    and c in df_test.columns
]

# Impute missing values with median
for col in numeric_feats:
    med = df_train[col].median()
    df_train[col] = df_train[col].fillna(med)
    df_test[col] = df_test[col].fillna(med)

X_num_train = np.asarray(df_train[numeric_feats], dtype=np.float32)
X_num_test = np.asarray(df_test[numeric_feats], dtype=np.float32)

# Process text features
text_cols = ["request_title", "request_text_edit_aware"]
df_train[text_cols] = df_train[text_cols].fillna("")
df_test[text_cols] = df_test[text_cols].fillna("")

tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=500, ngram_range=(1, 2), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=2
)
X_text_train = tfidf.fit_transform(df_train[text_cols].apply(" ".join, axis=1))
X_text_test = tfidf.transform(df_test[text_cols].apply(" ".join, axis=1))

# Combine numeric and text features
X_train_full = hstack([csr_matrix(X_num_train), X_text_train]).tocsr()
X_test_full = hstack([csr_matrix(X_num_test), X_text_test]).tocsr()

# Stratified train/validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Train LightGBM Classifier
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="auc",
    verbosity=-1,
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=400,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=6,
    num_leaves=31,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    min_child_samples=20,
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate test predictions
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_full)[:, 1]

# Save submission file
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sampleSubmission.csv")
sample_sub["requester_received_pizza"] = test_probs
sample_sub.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
